Five classic sandwiches -- roasted chicken club, New Orleans po'boy with oysters, muffuletta, applewood-smoked bacon and fried egg sandwich, and a Reuben.

Lamb navarin; Niçoise salad; a melted ham and cheese croque monsieur topped with a béchamel sauce; celery root rémoulade.

Glazed meatloaf; hot Italian-style pork sausage; making burgers using a custom blend of meats; meatballs with ricotta.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School

Beef bourguignon; cioppino, a tomato and wine-based fish stew; chicken Marsala; poached pears in red or white wine.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E4 — Arethusa Farm Dairy's Award Winning Cheese
Martha road trips to Arethusa Farm in Bantam, CT, and learns how they make their award-winning Europa cheese, visits their cheese caves, and makes their delicious cheesy risotto recipe.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E8 — The Science of Woks and Frying
Martha and Chef Kenji Lopez-Alt make extra-crunchy fried chicken sandwiches, tempura shrimp with vegetables, and finally a perfectly stir-fried beef with broccoli.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E4 — Pasta Night
Tonight is pasta night in Bedford; Martha and friends make three pasta dishes, including a recipe from her new restaurant, The Bedford, a no-knife spaghetti, and a lemon angel hair pasta.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E7 — A Classic French Dish: Pot Au Feu
Martha prepares pot-au-feu, a hearty French dish of root vegetables and various cuts of meat, all braised in a savory broth; it's served with sliced meat, vegetables and delicious accompaniments!

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E9 — Vietnamese Cuisine
Martha creates an incredible Vietnamese feast with her friend Monica Tran, including lettuce-wrapped golden fried spring rolls, traditional pho soup, and savory sizzling pancakes.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E10 — Azaleas, Hostas, and Wild Birds
Martha's azalea grove is bursting with the last flowers of spring; then everything you need to know about hostas; Martha takes up bird watching.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.
